## What it catches

Test files outside tests/ folders.

## As `layout({ scope: "@hosti/" })` builds it

```json
{
  "name": "tests-live-in-tests-dir",
  "severity": "error",
  "module": {
    "path": "^(?:apps|packages)/[^/]+/.*[.](?:test|spec)[.][^/]+$",
    "pathNot": "^(?:apps|packages)/[^/]+/src/(?:tests|.*/tests)/[^/]+[.](?:test|spec)[.][^/]+$",
    "numberOfDependentsLessThan": 100
  },
  "from": {}
}
```
